name: Macedonia di Frutta
description: A refreshing medley of seasonal fresh fruits macerated in lemon juice and a little sugar.
ingredients: a generous handful of baby spinach
a handful of fresh parsley, chopped
a generous spoonful of lemon zest
a pinch of red pepper flakes
instructions: Gather and prep the arborio rice and ground beef, measuring everything out so it is ready to go.
Heat unsalted butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat until warm but not smoking.
Add the sliced shallots and yellow onions, cooking gently until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the ground beef, season with red pepper flakes, and cook until just done, about 0 mins.
Warm the arborio rice alongside, turning once, until heated through and lightly toasted.
Plate the arborio rice and spoon the cooked mixture over the top.
tips: A squeeze of citrus or a sprinkle of basil just before serving brightens up the whole plate.
Prep the arborio rice and ground beef the night before to make busy mornings much easier.
Keep the heat moderate so the ground beef cooks through gently without drying out or turning rubbery.
